audit_phase: AQ-01R2 (second rerun of AQ-01, after AQ-02A then AQ-02B)
audit_type: Google AdSense & Content Quality Certification Audit
scope_note: Same methodology and scoring rubric as AQ-01 and AQ-01R, applied unchanged a second time. Every score below was re-derived by directly checking the live file tree after AQ-02B, not carried forward from AQ-02B's own certification reports (though those reports' specific claims were independently spot-checked and held up).

original_value.basis: Unaffected — AQ-02B did not touch entity/group/category content rendering.

helpful_content.basis: A visitor who now finds a useful page via search or the domain hub, rather than hitting a dead end, is more likely to actually use what AQ-02A published. Content itself unchanged.

eeat_signals.basis: The bearnaise/coconut relationship, elevated across two prior audits as the site's clearest example of unsourced content, is confirmed to have full documented provenance (data/runtime/sauce-condiment-editorial-relationships.json) — the prior audits checked the wrong data layer. AQ-02B's provenance verifier confirmed 0 unsupported relationships across a full census of 4,140 rendered relationships. This is a real, verified trust improvement, not a re-estimate. Offset slightly: the cheese scientific-name mislabeling and squash taxonomy-drift issues are now documented as full-domain findings (204 and 9 entities respectively) rather than single examples, though neither is new — both were already known in AQ-01 at smaller sample size and neither is live (cheese unpublished).

template_detection.basis: Unaffected — the wine-education-tier templating findings (noun-swap category sentence, leftover template variable) are untouched, re-confirmed verbatim.

entity_quality.basis: Referential integrity is now verified, not assumed: 0 duplicate slugs, 0 orphaned parent-group/category references, 0 unsupported relationships across a full site census. The bearnaise correction removes a false accuracy defect. Offset by fuller, more honest documentation of the taxonomy-drift pattern (9 squash-family entities, not 1) and the cheese mislabel (204 entities, full census) — neither newly discovered, both now more rigorously measured.

internal_linking.basis: A real breadth-first crawl (not link-count sampling) now confirms every published page is reachable: 51 previously-orphaned deprecated pages (found by this exact crawl, not assumed) now redirect to their canonical replacement. Sitemap coverage is deterministic and complete for all published domains. This was the single largest movement in this rerun.

navigation_quality.basis: The dominant defect across both prior audits — every food-domain hub 404ing — is fixed: 10 of 11 resolve, confirmed directly. /ingredients/ gives the site a single, consistent navigational entry point, linked from every relevant page type. Site search now covers the food ontology. Held below a higher score by: the wine-descriptor-glossary naming collision (/terms.html vs /terms/) is still unfixed, and cheese remains unpublished (by design, not defect).

adsense_readiness.basis: AQ-01R's own verdict named broken primary navigation as the specific, narrowed reason the site would still fail manual review after AQ-02A. That defect is fixed and independently verified. Remaining risk is smaller and more specific: dead 'View Bottle' links, unexplained confidence scores, and two now-fully-documented catalog accuracy findings awaiting an editorial pass rather than a publication fix.

tier_scale.platinum: 90-100 — comprehensive, original, consistently authoritative across the whole site
tier_scale.silver: 60-74 — solid core content, systemic gaps in a minority of the site
tier_scale.bronze: 40-59 — a genuine editorial core exists but is outnumbered or undermined by thin/broken content across the majority of the site
tier_scale.not_certified: 0-39 — thin/templated/broken content is the dominant visible experience

tier_note: 66/100 crosses into Silver for the first time across three measurements. This reflects the two remediation phases addressing genuinely different, complementary defects: AQ-02A fixed what the majority of pages said; AQ-02B fixed whether a reader could find and trust what they said. The remaining ceiling to Gold is now specific and bounded: wine-education-tier template language, two catalog-layer accuracy findings, and a handful of dead links on one page template — not a structural gap in either content or navigation.
would_pass_manual_adsense_review_today: More plausibly than before, though still not confidently yes. The two structural defects that drove prior 'no' verdicts (thin content at scale, broken primary navigation) are both resolved and independently verified. What would likely still draw a reviewer's attention: the wine-education tier's templated sentence patterns (a real AI-content-detection signature) and the non-functional 'View Bottle' links on dish pages. Neither is a site-wide pattern any longer — both are confined, specific, and were already fully scoped in recommended-improvements.md before this phase began.
